source.note: The owner chose to keep the currently adjudicated hotspot files monolithic. Scores were captured from the untruncated default-branch detector run that followed that decision. Issues 816, 860, 900, 916, and 1223 also carry the standing zero-conflict verdict recorded on 2026-08-23.

.claude/scripts/README.md.note: Re-anchored by Issue #1503. PR #1448 (Issue #898) moved every per-script row out of README.md into docs/, so the index no longer accretes a row per new script. Measured cleaned floor is 0 PRs — the detector does not report this path at all over the post-split window (--since 2026-08-28, --threshold 1), while 21 other files do. 2/2 is the schema minimum (pr_count_at_decision >= 2) and is the closest legal encoding of that 0; it re-arms the watch at score 4 instead of retiring it at 22. The join key stays 898 on purpose: the detector matches issues by the 'Refactor hotspot: <path>' title or the '<!-- churn-hotspot: <path> -->' body marker, and #1503 carries neither, so naming 1503 here would break baseline_for() and suppress this path forever as no_matching_baseline. Rationale and the expected window-drain transient: .claude/reference/scripts-readme-hotspot-decision.md.

.claude/scripts/estimate-resolve.sh.note: KEEP verdict on Issue #1513. Score 3 is the detector's threshold floor and post-creation churn is +5/-2: one creation PR (#1332) plus two repo-wide mechanical sweeps (#1379 empty-array-under-set-u, #1458 script-usage.log guard ordering) in which this file was a passenger. Zero conflict rounds. The audit that accompanied the verdict found --help dead on macOS here and in 11 sibling scripts; fixed in the same PR. Rationale: .claude/reference/estimate-resolve-hotspot-decision.md.

.claude/scripts/repo-root.sh.note: KEEP verdict on Issue #1475. Five PRs, zero conflict rounds, one driving event: #1386 -> #1422 -> #1467 is a single convergent hardening chain from the 2026-08-27 hang (#1363), #1458 is a one-line repo-wide sweep, and #1481 already performed the only available extraction (the wall-clock bound now lives in lib/bounded-run.sh, leaving this file 97 lines smaller). Rationale: .claude/reference/repo-root-hotspot-decision.md.

.claude/scripts/stale-cleanup.sh.note: KEEP verdict on Issue #1479. Five PRs, zero conflict rounds: one feature round (#1414, +731 lines, orphaned worktree-registration pruning), two one-line repo-wide mechanical sweeps (#1433, #1467), and two rounds of one bounded-exec concern that #1481 ended by extracting the primitives into lib/bounded-run.sh. Rationale: .claude/reference/stale-cleanup-hotspot-decision.md.
